title: Marketplace partner sprint notes
summary: Daybook for partner sprint: quick wins, integration checklist, blockers, and who to ping. Unpolished; meant as my single-source-of-truth today.
content:
Morning brain dump (2026-03-12)

08:30 — quick triage
- Skimmed PARTN-482 and responses from partner (SaaSX). Key ask: webhook retry semantics + shared secret rotation.
- Noted timeline pressure: partner wants soft launch next week; we need canary route + test dataset in staging.

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] Finish webhook retry doc fragment (send to Liam) — owner: Aisha — due: 2026-03-12 EOD
- [ ] Confirm staging dataset upload with Solutions Eng — owner: Marta — due: 2026-03-13 AM
- [ ] Validate end-to-end flow: partner -> Redwood hosted API -> webhook callback (simulate) — owner: Devon/Aisha — due: 2026-03-13
- [ ] Draft rollback / fallback strategy for when partner model is overloaded — owner: Aisha — due: 2026-03-14

Integration checklist (working; not final)
- API access
  - [x] API key created for partner (scoped, read-only to test routes)
  - [ ] Quota policy assigned (need committed burst values)
- Webhook / callbacks
  - [ ] Shared secret rotation plan documented (link to PARTN-490)
  - [ ] Retries: implement exponential backoff w/ 4 retries (spec in PR)
  - [ ] Replay window defined (how long to keep callbacks)
- Data handling
  - [ ] Confirm PII redaction checklist applies to partner payloads
  - [ ] Audit logs enabled for their requests (low-retention in staging ok)
- Observability
  - [ ] Add route-level latency and error dashboard panel for partner (console)
  - [ ] Set alert: 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5m -> page on-call SRE
- Rollout plan
  - [ ] Canary (5% traffic) -> 25% -> full; automatic rollback if error spike > threshold

Quick test artifacts / commands (for myself & Devon)
- curl test for webhook receiver (local ngrok):
  curl -X POST https://abcd-1234.ngrok.io/webhook -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"event":"inference:complete","payload":{"id":"test-01","result":"ok"}}'

- Simulated request to Redwood API (dev key):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-dev-xxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-small-debug","input":"hello"}'

Meeting notes (sync w/ SaaSX 10:00)
- They asked for explicit guidance on: secret rotation cadence, webhook replay semantics, data residency (EU-only for some tenants).
- Action items assigned: Liaise with Security (Marta) re: KMS integration; ask infra whether we can pin EU-only routes in Dedicated (Devon).
- Partner will provide sample payloads by EOD 2026-03-12. If not received, sprint slips one day.

Open questions / risks
- Risk: Partner expects SLA parity with our Hosted customers (they want 99.95). Need product decision on whether marketplace partners can purchase Dedicated-level SLA.
- Q: Should partner-facing webhooks attempt idempotency keys? Ops likes it but partners may not implement. Add in spec as recommended.
- Data: Is their sample payload containing audio attachments? If yes, need ingestion queue changes (higher storage cost).

Notes to self (informal)
- When writing webhook doc: include retry samples, pseudo-code for idempotency, and minimal payload example.
- Keep the spec simple — partners are onboarding dev leads, not infra experts. Provide working example repo.
- Slack message to #partners: ping Liam + Devon when PR merged.

Next steps (concrete)
1) Draft webhook doc (Aisha) -> add to Confluence, link in JIRA PARTN-490.
2) Run end-to-end smoke with devkey + ngrok -> record short Loom if successful (helps partner devs).
3) Create alert in Console for partner route and share dashboard link in PR.
4) If partner sample payloads include attachments, escalate to infra for cost estimate (cc: Raj).

End-of-day quick log (18:45)
- Progress: wrote 60% of webhook doc, ran curl smoke flow (received 200s from ngrok), opened GH draft PR for retry logic.
- Blockers: partner samples still partial (missing audio schema). Emailed partner lead (Sofia) for missing fields.
- Tomorrow: finalize doc, schedule canary window with SRE, confirm EU routing feasibility.

Random half-baked ideas (note to self)
- Could offer a "marketplace webhook test harness" UI in Console where partners can send test events and view traces — reduces back-and-forth. Nice to prototype in Q2.
- Small: embed sample Postman collection directly into onboarding email.

Triage log (links & tickets)
- PARTN-482: partner questions thread (need to respond to rotation Qs)
- PARTN-490: webhook retry + idempotency spec (draft)
- GH PR: marketplace-integration/pull/89 (retry logic)

If partner replies after 20:00 -> quick patch notes: 1) request missing schema, 2) offer temporary mapping via our transform layer, 3) propose meeting Fri AM

— Aisha
